parameters.name: queueState
parameters.description: Dispatcher queue filter. Overlapping fact-based filters, not a new exclusive status. DISPATCHER only, inside an allowed houseId; a missing houseId or an unknown value is 422. The cursor is bound to houseId and queueState. NEEDS_ACCEPTANCE: CONFIRMED without acceptedAt. NEEDS_ACTION: accepted, has an ACTIVE item without RESTORED that has no current nextAction, or observation PERSISTS, or an expired updateDueAt. AWAITING_AUTHOR: has an ACTIVE REPORTED_DONE item with NOT_RECEIVED or CANNOT_CHECK. ARCHIVED: has an ARCHIVED item. All four are live: reports exist since S-04 and the archive command since S-05.

get.description: Только чтение. Подсказка никогда не меняет workStatus, раунд или наблюдение: связь подтверждает диспетчер через /links. result заполнен только при READY; при QUEUED, RUNNING, STALE и MANUAL_REQUIRED он null. STALE значит, что подсказка была получена, но пункт с тех пор сменил contentVersion или workRound, либо обращение сменило sourceRevision, - поэтому она не показывается. Ответ STUB хранится, но отдаётся как MANUAL_REQUIRED.

get.description: Ascending by createdAt then eventId, cursor-paginated, at most 50 events per page. details carries allow-listed fields per event type and never raw payload, secrets or free text. The cursor is bound to its case and is not a credential: access is re-checked on every page.

404.description: Обращение недоступно: чужой дом, отозванный доступ или чужой черновик неотличимы от отсутствия

displayNumber.description: Human-readable case number. Assigned when the case row is created, never reused, never re-issued.

type.description: Optional problem type. Some current domain errors omit this field.

instance.description: Optional request path in domain errors; security-filter errors may omit it.

Membership.description: One house context of the current user. The role belongs to this house only and is never taken from the client.

MeView.description: Verified MAX user and currently active memberships. Profile displayName, username and avatarUrl come only from signed MAX initData, remain in the server session and grant no permissions. Optional profile data may be null. Empty memberships means a verified account without house access, not an implicit RESIDENT.

username.description: MAX username from signed initData, without an added @ prefix; null when unavailable.

avatarUrl.description: Optional absolute HTTPS image URL from signed initData, without URL credentials. Java does not download this URL.

CasePage.description: One page of visible cases. nextCursor is opaque, bound to the filter it was issued for, and is not a credential: membership is re-checked on every page.

CaseReceipt.description: Four independent facts of a case never collapse into one status: this record carries only the two case-level timestamps. Acceptance never changes workStatus or observation. acceptedBy is exposed only to a reader allowed to see it.

NextAction.description: A plan, never a report: it never implies that work happened. ownerId is an active dispatcher of this house. An overdue plan stays visible as is; the server never shifts updateDueAt forward. Kept after archiving as a historical plan, not as a live promise.

displayNumber.description: Human-readable case number. Assigned when the case row is created, never reused, never re-issued.

TargetCaseView.description: TARGET (S-04+). AuthorCaseView plus allowedActions; not returned by Java yet, so no implemented operation may answer with it. allowedActions is an interface convenience: the server re-checks every command and never trusts it as a permission.

ReportLink.description: A dispatcher-confirmed link. Only this makes a report concern an item, opening a new round for that item alone.

WorkReportView.description: Immutable report text plus its scope and confirmed links. Saving a report changes no item: workStatus, workRound and observation stay as they were.

Analysis.description: A hint about the text, never a business status. When analysis is disabled the answer is MANUAL_REQUIRED; when enabled a fresh report is QUEUED. RUNNING and STALE are derived at read time and never stored. READY never means work happened.

SuggestionEvidence.description: Offsets are Unicode code points into reportText, start inclusive and end exclusive; quote equals that slice.

ItemSuggestion.description: Mirrors inference Suggestion. evidence is null exactly when relation is INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION without a quote.

ComparisonResult.description: The validated inference answer as stored; one suggestion per target item of the report, including items the text never mentions.

ReportSuggestions.description: Advisory only. analysisId is null when no analysis was ever queued for the report.

LinkInput.description: Three expected values guard three different drifts: the item row, its content, and its round. A link is news about work, so NOT_ASSIGNED is not a valid workStatus.

targetItemIds.description: Items this report may concern. Scope for a later link, never a claim that work happened.

links.description: Applied atomically: one refused link leaves the whole set unapplied. A repeated itemId is refused by the server; JSON Schema cannot express uniqueness by one property.

RecordObservation.description: The author's answer for one item, for this exact content version and round. NOT_RECEIVED is the absence of an answer and is never sent. AFTER_REPORT requires workStatus REPORTED_DONE in this round; INDEPENDENT does not and changes no work status.

DecideItem.description: Both decisions are final: the contract has no way back, a new problem is a new item. Neither reduces progress.total. WITHDRAW counts into progress.withdrawn; ARCHIVE does not and leaves the item in progress.remaining. Archiving keeps an observation the author already gave, never creates one, and keeps nextAction as a historical plan.

HistoryEvent.description: One audit event as the case's participants may see it. eventType today is one of CASE_CREATED, CASE_SOURCE_PATCHED, CASE_ITEMS_PATCHED, CASE_CONFIRMED, CASE_ACCEPTED, ITEM_NEXT_ACTION_SET, REPORT_SAVED, REPORT_LINK_CONFIRMED, OBSERVATION_RECORDED, ITEM_ADMINISTRATIVE_DECISION; an unrecognised type still appears, with empty details.

details.description: Allow-listed fields for this event type only: identifiers, counts, versions, rounds and enum values. caseId is dropped because the path carries it. Report text, a source text and an administrative reason never appear here.

HistoryPage.description: One page of history. nextCursor is opaque, bound to the case it was issued for, and null on the last page.
